stem: A parent reports that a child with otitis media with effusion seems to hear less well; what type of hearing problem is most expected?

options.text: Reduced hearing with a conductive pattern
A finding that proves mastoid abscess
A reason for routine antibiotic treatment

explanation: Reduced hearing with a conductive pattern is the expected hearing problem in otitis media with effusion.

citations.source: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf
citations.title: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes

optionExplanations.A: Incorrect because otitis media with effusion commonly causes reduced hearing.
optionExplanations.B: Correct because otitis media with effusion typically causes a conductive hearing loss due to middle ear fluid reducing sound transmission.
optionExplanations.C: Incorrect because most children with otitis media with effusion do not develop long-term cognitive decline from the condition alone.
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because reduced hearing from otitis media with effusion does not by itself indicate mastoid abscess.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because otitis media with effusion does not routinely require antibiotic treatment.
